name: Notchify v1.0.1 – Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements
body: # 🚀 Release Notes v1.0.1 [English](#english) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#bahasa-indonesia) --- ## 🇬🇧 English ### What's New in v1.0.1 This update focuses on making Notchify significantly lighter on your Mac's battery and memory, fixing reported bugs with buttons and shortcuts, keeping your clipboard private, and completely eliminating unexpected crashes. --- #### ☀️ Sleek Brightness & Volume HUD * **Brightness Directly in Your Notch:** Adjusting your screen brightness now shows up beautifully inside the notch, completely replacing the bulky macOS square overlay in the middle of your screen. * **Support for Custom Shortcut Keys:** Whether you use default Apple brightness keys (F14/F15) or custom remapped shortcuts (such as F5 and F6 on Hackintosh or external keyboards), Notchify automatically detects and intercepts them smoothly. * **Instant Volume Setup:** Accessibility permission is now recognized in real time—no need to restart the app after granting permission. * **Smart Unmute:** When you unmute your Mac, the volume returns to the exact level it was before muting, rather than jumping to a default level. * **Persistent Permissions:** Notchify's app identity is now hardened so macOS won't repeatedly ask you to grant accessibility permissions after updates. #### 📥 Temporary File Shelf (Drop Zone) * **Responsive Buttons:** Fixed an issue where the file card's 'X' (remove) button and the action buttons at the bottom wouldn't respond to clicks. Everything now clicks smoothly and reliably. * **Smooth Drag & Drop:** Easily drag staged files directly from your notch into Finder, Desktop, Slack, Mail, WhatsApp, or any other app. * **Double-Click to Open:** Quickly open any file placed in the shelf with a simple double-click. #### ⚡ Snappy Performance & Battery Saver * **Zero RAM Buildup:** Fixed a memory leak where repeatedly opening and closing the notch caused memory usage to creep up. Notchify stays featherlight even when running all day. * **Cooler & Longer Battery Life:** Smarter fullscreen detection and relaxed background updates keep your MacBook running cool and conserve battery while you work or watch movies. * **Snappy Agenda:** Viewing your calendar and schedule is now faster and lighter on the processor. #### 🛡️ Stability & Crash Prevention * **VPN Crash-Proof:** Fixed a bug that caused Notchify to unexpectedly quit when connecting or disconnecting VPNs and virtual networks. * **Cleaner Speed Tests:** Network speed tests now automatically clean up after themselves, freeing memory immediately upon completion. * **Accurate Network Speeds:** The download and upload speed indicators now accurately display high-speed internet connections without glitches. * **Sleep-Resistant Timers:** The Pomodoro timer now tracks actual target time, ensuring your countdown stays accurate even if your Mac goes to sleep. #### 🪞 Camera & Quick Mirror * **Smooth Camera Launch:** Opening the instant mirror from the notch runs in its own dedicated lane, preventing the screen or camera preview from freezing. * **Organized Captures:** Captured photos and video recordings are automatically stamped with detailed timestamps so they never accidentally overwrite previous files. #### 🔒 Privacy & Focus * **Password Shield:** Notchify automatically detects passwords copied from password managers (1Password, Bitwarden, Apple Keychain, etc.) and excludes them from your clipboard history to keep your sensitive data safe. * **Uninterrupted Typing:** Accidentally hovering over the notch will no longer steal your keyboard focus or interrupt your typing in other applications. * **Reliable Weather Status:** The weather widget will no longer get stuck on "Loading..." when offline and will gracefully show when a connection is unavailable. #### 💻 Mac Compatibility * **Universal Binary:** Runs natively with top performance on **Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4)** and **Intel Macs**. * **macOS Support:** Fully compatible with macOS 12 (Monterey), 13 (Ventura), 14 (Sonoma), and 15 (Sequoia). --- ## 🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia ### Apa yang Baru di v1.0.1 Pembaruan kali ini difokuskan untuk membuat Notchify terasa jauh lebih ringan di memori (RAM) dan baterai, memperbaiki tombol yang sebelumnya sulit diklik, menjaga privasi kata sandi Anda, serta mencegah aplikasi tiba-tiba tertutup sendiri (*crash*). --- #### ☀️ Pengatur Kecerahan Layar & Volume di Poni * **Kecerahan Layar di Area Poni:** Mengatur terang-gelapnya layar kini tampil elegan langsung di area poni layar, menggantikan pop-up kotak abu-abu bawaan Mac yang biasanya menutupi bagian tengah layar. * **Mendukung Tombol Pintasan Bebas (Termasuk Hackintosh & Keyboard Eksternal):** Notchify sekarang otomatis mengenali tombol pintasan kecerahan apa pun yang Anda atur di Pengaturan Mac Anda (seperti tombol F5 dan F6), tanpa perlu setting manual lagi. * **Izin Akses Langsung Aktif:** Begitu Anda memberikan izin aksesibilitas, pengatur volume dan pintasan langsung aktif seketika tanpa perlu menutup dan membuka ulang aplikasi. * **Volume Kembali Pas Saat Batal Bisu:** Saat suara dinyalakan kembali dari mode hening (*unmute*), tingkat suara akan kembali persis ke volume sebelumnya, bukan melonjak ke setelan awal. * **Izin Akses Tetap Awet:** Izin aksesibilitas Mac Anda kini tersimpan aman dan tidak akan meminta izin ulang terus-menerus setiap kali Anda memperbarui aplikasi. #### 📥 Tempat Penyimpanan File Sementara (*Drop Zone*) * **Tombol Berfungsi Lancar:** Masalah tombol silang (❌) pada kartu file yang sebelumnya tidak bisa diklik serta tombol aksi di bawahnya kini sudah diperbaiki sepenuhnya dan responsif saat diklik. * **Tarik & Lepas (*Drag & Drop*) Mudah:** Anda bisa langsung menyeret file dari poni layar ke Finder, Desktop, WhatsApp, Slack, Email, atau aplikasi lainnya dengan sangat mudah. * **Klik Ganda untuk Buka:** Cukup klik dua kali pada file di dalam poni untuk langsung membukanya di aplikasi bawaan Mac Anda. #### ⚡ Lebih Ringan, Gesit, & Hemat Baterai * **Bebas Lemot & Hemat RAM:** Memperbaiki masalah penggunaan memori yang sebelumnya perlahan menumpuk saat poni layar sering dibuka-tutup. Notchify kini tetap sangat enteng meski dibiarkan menyala seharian. * **Baterai MacBook Lebih Awet:** Deteksi saat Anda menonton video layar penuh (*fullscreen*) serta pembaruan cuaca di latar belakang kini jauh lebih hemat daya, menjaga baterai MacBook Anda lebih tahan lama dan suhu laptop tetap adem. * **Buka Kalender & Jadwal Lebih Cepat:** Menampilkan agenda kegiatan kini terasa instan tanpa membebani prosesor laptop. #### 🛡️ Bebas Macet & Bebas Crash * **Aman Saat Pakai VPN:** Notchify tidak akan lagi tiba-tiba keluar sendiri (*force close*) saat Anda menyambungkan atau memutuskan koneksi VPN. * **Tes Kecepatan Internet Lebih Bersih:** Menguji kecepatan internet kini otomatis merapikan sisa memorinya sendiri setelah tes selesai. * **Indikator Kecepatan Internet Akurat:** Pemantau kecepatan unduh dan unggah kini membaca koneksi internet berkecepatan tinggi dengan tepat tanpa ada salah hitung. * **Timer Tidak Bergeser:** Timer Pomodoro kini menghitung waktu target sesungguhnya, sehingga hitungan mundur tetap pas meskipun laptop Mac Anda sempat tidur (*sleep*). #### 🪞 Cermin Kilat & Kamera * **Cermin Lebih Mulus & Anti Macet:** Membuka fitur cermin dari poni kini berjalan di jalurnya sendiri sehingga layar laptop Anda tidak akan membeku (*freeze*). * **Penyimpanan Foto & Video Lebih Rapi:** Foto atau rekaman video yang Anda ambil otomatis diberi penanda waktu yang jelas sehingga tidak akan saling menimpa file lama. #### 🔒 Privasi Terjaga & Fokus Bekerja * **Perlindungan Kata Sandi:** Notchify otomatis mendeteksi dan **tidak akan menyimpan** riwayat salinan kata sandi dari aplikasi pengelola sandi (seperti 1Password, Bitwarden, atau Rantai Kunci Apple). Data rahasia Anda tetap 100% aman! * **Fokus Mengetik Tidak Terganggu:** Saat kursor mouse Anda tidak sengaja menyentuh poni layar, kursor mengetik Anda di dokumen atau aplikasi lain tidak akan tiba-tiba loncat atau hilang fokus. * **Info Cuaca Lebih Ramah:** Kartu cuaca tidak akan lagi macet di tulisan "Memuat..." saat internet Anda terputus, melainkan memberi tahu status koneksi dengan jelas. #### 💻 Kompatibilitas Mac * **Universal Binary:** Berjalan mulus dan optimal di semua Mac, baik **Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4)** maupun **Mac berbasis Intel**. * **Dukungan macOS:** Mendukung penuh macOS 12 (Monterey), 13 (Ventura), 14 (Sonoma), hingga macOS 15 (Sequoia).

name: Notchify v1.0.0 — Dynamic Island for macOS (Universal Binary)
body:
# 🏝️ Notchify v1.0.0 — Dynamic Island Experience for macOS

**Notchify** transforms your MacBook notch (and non-notch Macs) into a powerful, interactive Apple Dynamic Island. Designed natively with Swift and SwiftUI, Notchify seamlessly blends into macOS with glassmorphism aesthetics, fluid spring physics, and zero lag.

---

## ⚡ What's New in v1.0.0

### 🎵 1. Multi-App Media Player & Real-Time Synced Lyrics
- **Universal Player Support:** Controls Spotify Desktop, Apple Music, and Web Browsers (YouTube Music, SoundCloud, podcasts) with track scrubbing and volume gestures.
- **Ultra-Fast Synced Lyrics Engine:** Automatically fetches synchronized karaoke-style scrolling lyrics in < 0.4s online.
- **Side-by-Side Lyrics Expansion:** Dual-pane layout featuring high-res album art with dynamic ambient glow on the left and smooth auto-scrolling lyrics on the right.
- **Settings Toggle & Empty State:** Option to disable lyric fetching in Settings, featuring an instant in-card re-enable action.

### 📋 2. Smart Clipboard Manager
- **History & Live Search:** Quick-access clipboard stack with real-time text filter.
- **Pin Items (📌):** Pin essential snippets to keep them pinned at the top even after clearing history.
- **Smart Data Detector:** Automatic detection for HEX/RGB color codes with live color preview swatches, web URLs with one-click browser open, emails, file paths, phone numbers, and currencies.

### 📦 3. Drop Zone / File Shelf
- **Drag & Drop Staging:** Hold files near the notch to expand the drop zone shelf.
- **Native AirDrop & Sharing:** Share files via macOS AirDrop, Mail, or Messages directly from the notch.
- **Quick Open & Metadata:** View file size badges and launch files in their default apps.

### ⏱️ 4. Focus Pomodoro Timer
- **Customizable Intervals:** Focus, short break, and long rest timers with right-click quick adjustments (+/- 5m).
- **Detached Island Pill:** Minimized dynamic pill beside the notch when collapsed with clickable quick expansion.
- **Native Audio Chimes:** Elegant macOS system sounds alert you when work or rest sessions finish.

### 📸 5. Quick Camera Mirror & Video Recorder
- **Instant Mirror:** Preview your camera before video calls with customizable virtual ring lights (Cool, Neutral, Warm).
- **HD Video Recording:** Quick video capture with live recording pill HUD and in-tab playback preview.

### 📊 6. System & Network Monitor
- **Hardware Telemetry:** Real-time CPU, RAM, battery health, and charging animations.
- **Built-in Network Speedometer:** High-precision real-time download and upload speed test.

### 🐾 7. Interactive Notch Companion (Mascot)
- **Lively Dynamic Expressions:** Reactive companion that winks, blinks, smiles, and reacts to system events.
- **120 BPM Music Rhythm:** Maskot bounces and bobs its head to the beat when music is playing.
- **Activity Aware:** Remains awake while typing or moving the mouse; enters deep sleep only when the Mac is left idle for >90s.

---

##  Universal 2 Binary & System Requirements
- **Universal Binary:** Natively compiled for both **Apple Silicon** (M1, M2, M3, M4) and **Intel Macs** (`arm64` + `x86_64`).
- **macOS Requirement:** macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later.
- **Displays:** Compatible with MacBook Pro/Air camera notches and external monitors.

---

## 🌐 Full Bilingual Support
- Switch between **Bahasa Indonesia** and **English** seamlessly in Preferences.

---

## 📥 Installation
1. Download **`Notchify.dmg`** below.
2. Open the disk image and drag **Notchify** into your **Applications** folder.
3. Launch Notchify and enjoy your dynamic notch experience!
